extracted.name: Chicken Vegetable Stir Fry
extracted.description: If you’re in the mood for an Asian-inspired dish but don’t have much time, this is the recipe for you! Everyone will love this combination of chicken breast, veggies, and sauces.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in 3/4-inch pieces
2 large red or yellow bell peppers, chopped
1 cup snow peas, cut in 3/4-inch pieces
2 (8.8 ounce) pouches UNCLE BEN'S® READY RICE® - Whole Grain Brown
instruction_lines: In large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Cook and stir chicken, peppers, and onion 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetables soften and chicken is no longer pink.
Stir in bean sprouts and pea pods; cook 1 minute. Stir in water, soy sauce, and fish sauce.
Meanwhile heat rice as directed on package. Stir into chicken mixture, heating about 2 minutes until thoroughly combined. Garnish with sesame seed.
